meta_description: Peter Smith Painting & Decorating in Sheffield. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorative finishes. Free quotes, reliable local service.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and specialist finishes across Sheffield and Rotherham.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Sheffield
services_subhead: From interior redecorating to exterior facias, we handle every project with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Wallpapering
services.desc: Refresh your living spaces with expert interior painting and quality wallpaper installation. We prepare surfaces properly, use premium paints, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Protect and enhance your home's exterior with durable exterior paints and cladding work. We handle fascias, soffits, and weatherproofing for lasting results.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Create a distinctive look with textured finishes, Artex removal, and decorative paint effects. Perfect for feature walls, hallways, and period properties.

services.title: Furniture & Cabinet Painting
services.desc: Revive tired furniture and kitchen units with professional spray or brush painting. We prepare, prime, and finish to a showroom standard.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Office redecorating, retail spaces, and commercial projects completed on schedule and within budget. Minimal disruption to your business.

services.title: Consultation & Colour Advice
services.desc: Unsure which colours work together? We offer free in-home consultations and colour matching to help you choose the perfect scheme.

about_pullquote: I do every job as if I'm decorating my own home—no shortcuts, no excuses.
about_para_1: Peter Smith Painting & Decorating has been transforming homes and businesses across Sheffield and Rotherham for over 20 years. Starting out as a one-man operation, Peter built his reputation on honest work, attention to detail, and a genuine commitment to leaving properties better than he found them. Today, Peter still leads every project personally, ensuring the same quality and care that made his name in the first place.
about_para_2: His customers return again and again because Peter listens to what you want, offers practical colour advice, and always cleans up before he leaves. He specialises in both modern and period properties, from small flat redecorating to large commercial jobs, and takes pride in finishing on time and on budget.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Peter

reviews.text: Absolute perfectionist. Peter decorated our lounge and two bedrooms, and the finish is immaculate. He protected everything, kept the dust to a minimum, and didn't leave until it was spotless. Honestly can't fault him. Already planning the next rooms with him.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Had Peter in to wallpaper our hallway and paint the kitchen. He was friendly, professional, and gave us loads of colour options before he started. Finished two days ahead of schedule and the quality is really impressive. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Been using Peter for about five years now. He's done our whole house in that time. Never lets you down, always reliable, and his prices are fair. It's hard to find someone you can trust in this trade—Peter is the real deal.
reviews.author: Sue M.
